risks.risk: The engine may not be a Cat 3208 or may be a different model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the side or front).
risks.if_unproven: as a generic used marine engine

risks.risk: The engine may be incomplete or missing essential accessories like the alternator or fuel pump.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare engine without accessories

risks.risk: The engine may be seized or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a compression test result.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate showing the model number.
Photo of the engine with all included accessories (alternator, fuel pump, etc.).
Video of the engine running or a compression test result.
